sources.title: arXiv:2506.01475v1 [cs.AI] 2 Jun 2025
sources.snippet: We further introduce PGPO, a preference op-timization method that empowers LLM agents with enhanced reasoning capabilities under the guidance of pseudocode-style plans. Experimental results reveal that our PGPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on repre-sentative agent benchmarks, especially when dealing with more complex agent tasks.

sources.snippet: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated impressive capabilities in handling complex interactive problems. Existing LLM agents mainly generate natural language plans to guide reasoning, which is verbose and inefficient.
